title: A gate question that names the seconds, darwin or suite's ceiling is classed ceiling, not design
goal: bl_authority's ceiling question words match the wordings the rules use for the suite ceiling ('seconds ceiling', 'darwin ceiling', 'the suite's ceiling', 'ceiling for the test suite', 'tests.py ceiling', max_seconds), so a gate such as 'Raise the darwin seconds ceiling to 40 s?' on an item with no ceiling touch is of class ceiling; the authority test plants those wordings

run: import sys;sys.path.insert(0,'_tools');import bl_authority as a;sys.exit(0 if all(a.gate_class({'touches':[]},{'question':q})=='ceiling' for q in ('Raise the darwin seconds ceiling to 40 s?','Which value does the suite\'s ceiling take?','Raise max_seconds for darwin?')) else 1)
